relations: Dry grass along the horizontal fire band feeds flames that flicker and stretch while the line stays roughly fixed.
Rising black smoke from the flames churns and spreads upward as the fire continues burning.
Low white wisps over the charred patch drift and fade subtly while nearby grass remains unburnt.
Broad upper-left smoke cloud changes shape slowly above the distant pale haze.
caption: The video captures a dry-grass field where a horizontal band of fire already burns across the middle, an ongoing blaze rather than a new ignition. Thick black smoke rises from the flames, while a broad grey-brown cloud fills the upper-left sky and pale haze hangs over distant trees. In the foreground, unburnt golden grass sits below a charred black patch emitting low wisps of white smoke. The fire line holds roughly the same horizontal position, but flame tongues on both clusters continuously flicker, stretch, and deform. The dark plume above the fire churns and spreads as it rises, and the broad top cloud changes shape slowly. White wisps over the charred patch move and fade subtly, while the framing shows no obvious movement.
